TasteProfile.title: TasteProfile
TasteProfile.description: Signed-in customer's dietary and cuisine preferences used to personalize dish recommendations.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who owns this preference profile.

dietaryMode.description: Dietary filter preference for personalized recommendations.

favoriteCategories.description: Up to 4 preferred cuisine categories selected by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the taste profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the taste profile was last updated.

OrderRecord.title: OrderRecord
OrderRecord.description: COD food delivery order belonging strictly to a signed-in customer for syncing order history and personalized recommendations.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the customer who placed the order.

grandTotal.description: Total Cash on Delivery amount in INR.

longestPrepMins.description: Longest dish prep time in minutes among items in the order.

deliveryMins.description: Delivery dispatch minutes added to prep time.

estimatedTotalMins.description: Total estimated minutes from placement to delivery.

placedAt.description: Formatted local time string when order was placed.

placedDate.description: Formatted local date string when order was placed.

customerName.description: Recipient full name (PII isolated to owner).

customerPhone.description: Recipient phone number (PII isolated to owner).

customerAddress.description: Recipient delivery address (PII isolated to owner).

itemIds.description: Bounded list of ordered menu item IDs (max 30).

itemQuantities.description: Bounded list of ordered quantities matching itemIds (max 30).

otpEnabled.description: Whether 4-digit OTP verification was enabled when placing the order.

orderOtp.description: Freshly generated 4-digit numeric OTP for this order when otpEnabled is true.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when order was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when order status was last updated.

/users/{userId}/profile/{docId}.description: Stores each signed-in user's dietary and cuisine preferences under docId 'preferences'.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Private per-user COD order history and live fulfillment status.
